commonRules: Write the case-map tests of the mandate FIRST, under exactly the titles docs/design/B10-case-map.md cites, and see them fail before building.
Real PostgreSQL 17 for every database claim, through the runtime login roles (kauro_app, kauro_payment, kauro_commission, kauro_control); the superuser only as oracle; never a database fake.
Interleavings by hold points and lock waits observed in pg_stat_activity; never a sleep as synchronization.
Every instant is kauro.server_now(); durations are exact hours; calendar months only through America/Bogota; tests stand at another instant only through the labelled TEST CLOCK (D10-CLOCK-1).

Money is integer cents (bigint in TypeScript, BIGINT within kauro.is_money in SQL), rounded half-up once through B09's kernel (roundHalfUpBps, allocateLargestRemainder, cumulativeEntitlement, entitlementAdjustment) or kauro.round_half_up_bps; never a float, never a second rounding. The worked examples' integer cents are the oracle, written in the test, never read back from the function under test.

A fake has exactly one owner (D10-FAKE-1): integrationClass CONTRACT_FAKE, evidenceClass SIMULATED, a call log, contract-fake-* tokens, on a test-only testing subpath, bound by no composition root. B09's and B07's fakes are reused, never copied.

Own only the files the task names. Repositories are reached through accessor functions over the unit of work (B09's purchasedSubjectsOf pattern), so no parallel lane edits a shared factory; shared expectation lists (migrations list, machine seeds, event types, subscriptions, runtime-boundary.json, served inventory, matrix rows) change additively and are reviewed entry by entry.
Focused tests while working; one full pnpm run verify at the end on Windows (the integrators also on Linux). Stop every PostgreSQL cluster you start.
A deviation from the design is one or two sentences with its citation in the decisions register of docs/design/B10-commercial-domain.md, with the case map updated in the same commit.
When the mandate lands, its case-map rows lose PLANNED and gain the commit; the status table follows. Records stay short: case | test file :: exact title | status | commit.
No deferred-work markers (to-do or fix-me tags) in code or documents. A new dependency is pinned, justified in the design and committed with the lockfile.
Commit early with the owner's identity and the session's attribution lines; never push; never write the product's earlier brand name (the registry's owner role is written KAURO_OWNER).
